title: DAILYDILEMMAS: REVEALING VALUE PREFERENCES OF LLMS WITH QUANDARIES OF DAILY LIFE

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM action choices on a dataset of 1,360 binary-choice everyday moral dilemmas and mapping the underlying human values to five theoretical frameworks (e.g., World Values Survey, Moral Foundations Theory) to quantify structural preferences for specific cultural norms (e.g., Western-aligned preferences for self-expression over survival).
